step1.description:
Back in November 2021 when I first put out the idea of a Reactive Language compiling to Solid I only had a vague idea of what I wanted out of it. A lot has changed in the last 3 years. React's compiler was announced and released. Svelte 5 is in preview bringing compilation to their new adoption of Signals. So let's take some time to explore where things are at today.

Original article: https://dev.to/this-is-learning/the-quest-for-reactivescript-3ka3
